event.description: Deck registration required - we will not be able to start the event if you don't have your deck registration in. Registration is 500Php which includes 1 booster pack and 1 event pack. Champion will be getting an Ascent Invite Ticket and 2nd place will get a Merlin Deck Box. We will be an hour earlier then the usual tournaments. We aim to start on time so be at the tournament premises at least 30 minutes before 2pm.
